critique: The paper-white field, crisp black hinges, and flashes of vermilion, green, blue, amber, and pink make the reversible “folded weather” premise unusually legible, high-key, and visually punchy. Yet nine evenly spaced horizontal strips driven by the same sinusoidal fold cycle revert to a familiar kinetic pattern; varying the bands’ geometry, timing logic, or hinge relationships would better fulfill the brief’s demand for an unfamiliar visual grammar.
